title: ר' חייא בר מתנא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Mattana, student of Shmuel. Niddah 60b has bar Rav Mattana, in Rav's name, and Rav Nachman said to him. I do not know the basis for the statement “student of Shmuel.” Perhaps it is because R. Mattana, son of R. Yochanan, was Shmuel's student; but he is called Rav Mattana.
